title.narrative: Institutional Capacity for National Economic Censuses(FY05-FY08)

description.narrative: China.s statistical system is in transition from the previous Soviet-style model to the modern UN System of National Accounts. National income accounts are vital to track the economycomma formulate policiescomma and to support the functioning of marketscomma but the current system is based on outmoded and incomplete surveyscomma weak collection and processing methodscomma and basic technical flaws. As the first major step in overhauling the national statistical effortcomma and in line with official prioritiescomma the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) will replace the current fragmented surveys and collection/analysis methods with national economic censusescomma the first to be implemented in early 2005. Thereaftercomma the economic census (EC) will be the core of the national statistical effortcomma and monthlycomma quarterly and annual statistics to track the economy will be based upon it. In additioncomma it will provide the statistical basis for quantitative modeling to support economic decision-making. This project will assist NBS with: (a) re-orienting the existing organization of national accounts compilation units; (b) completing a newcomma expanded and accurate registry of establishments to survey; (c) training trainers and statistical enumerators and other personnel in NBS (the agricultural census of 1996 required 5 million enumerators); and (d) introducing internationally-benchmarked practices for the management and processing of the first and subsequent economic censuses. Several required organizational changes and management and statistical processes were tested last year in the STATCAP-supported projectcomma and therefore have helped to focus work on the economic censuses. This project is intended to strengthen China's capacity in statistical effort. The objective of this project is in line with the overall goal of the Tenth Five-year Plan for the Social and Economic Development of China and the knowledge agenda emphasized in the recent Country Assistance Strategy for China. An improved statistical system will provide better qualitycomma more relevant and more frequent data to support the functioning of China.s market economycomma evidence-based policy makingcomma and the implementation of the development strategy of the government. To assist the Recipient in strengthening its statistical capacity building by supporting the first National Economic Census (EC).
